## v13.3.0

Telegram shop customization and dashboard refresh.

- Add an Appearance editor with a live Telegram menu preview, shop name, Persian and English greetings, announcements, custom button labels, compact or spacious menus, optional buttons, and support/tutorial links.
- Add shared panel accent colors and compact controls, with consistent light/dark styling and mobile RTL layouts.
- Add Persian translations for the new controls, statuses, validation messages, prices, and durations.
- Fix nested appearance settings not saving, including announcements returning after being cleared.
- Show unsaved settings with Save and Discard actions, plus warnings before navigating away or reloading.
- Refresh bot statistics and lists automatically every 30 seconds, with 10/30/60-second and Off options. Refreshes preserve unsaved settings and pause while the page is hidden.
- Replace em dashes in panel and bot interface text with normal hyphens.

Existing bot configurations migrate automatically. Updates that omit appearance settings preserve the saved customization. Panel accent and density preferences are stored in the browser.

Includes the fixes from v13.2.3. Linux archives include the matching installer, updater, service files, Xray, MTProto sidecar, and geodata. Release archives have SHA-256 checksums.

Validation: full local verification passed, including all Go tests, 1,848 frontend tests, lint, type checking, frontend and Storybook builds. Browser checks covered saving and clearing announcements, live statistics refresh while editing, Save/Discard, navigation/reload warnings, and Persian mobile layouts at 320px and 390px.
